signal_text: Gumroad's help center article on Getting Paid states that PayPal payouts are always processed in USD, usually in 1-3 business days, require an individual or business PayPal account without restrictions, and that Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, and wire transfer are not supported as payout methods.
subject_exact: Gumroad PayPal payout currency (USD) and processing time for sellers in non-bank-payout countries
local_qualifiers: If bank payouts are not supported in your country
extraction_notes: Payout layer. PayPal payout currency fixed at USD. Processing time given as 'usually 1-3 business days' — 'usually' qualifier preserved. Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, wire transfer explicitly excluded.
